news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.95 (up from ₹0.50 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.43b (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹56.7m (up 161% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.0% (up from 1.8% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 49% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
